stemMd: The lines y=(k−1)x+4 and y=3x−2 are parallel. What is k?
explanationMd: Parallel lines have equal slopes. Set k−1=3 to obtain k=4. Their different intercepts ensure they are distinct parallel lines.

distractorRationale.d: This equates k itself rather than k−1 to the slope.
distractorRationale.a: The intercept difference is unrelated to the slope condition.
